parties: Sharda Motor Industries Limited; Indira Choudhary
headline: Indira Choudhary Discloses Substantial Acquisition in Sharda Motor Industries
sum: Indira Choudhary has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition or share acquisition event in Sharda Motor Industries Limited; the filing was submitted to NSE.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures trigger public scrutiny of control thresholds and open-offer obligations—review whether the acquisition crosses the 25% threshold triggering a mandatory open offer under SEBI Takeover Code and confirm the acquirer's intent and funding structure.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Indira Choudhary has submitted a formal disclosure to the exchange regarding acquisition of shares in Sharda Motor Industries Limited. The filing occurs at the NSE (National Stock Exchange) and relates to a substantial acquisition event. The specific shareholding percentage, consideration amount, and transaction timeline are not detailed in the headline filing itself.
